messages.subject: [PATCH] Fix compilation with OpenJDK
messages.body_snippet:
This patch removes an unused import that breaks compilation with OpenJDK:

messages.subject: Re: Fix compilation with OpenJDK
messages.body_plain:
Applied!
Huge thanks for the rapid fix.

P.S. Have you tried Renjin on JATO? I noticed that there is work being
done on using SSA instructions, which in principle could provide a
boost for some of the more math intensive parts of Renjin.

Best,

Alex
